material_edit.source_ranges: shots[].offset is source seconds; from/frames are global output frames. Sources are SHA-bound, original-rate and muted; source length and actual reviewed interval must contain every selected frame.
material_edit.cut_policy: Continuous complete main timeline with half-open [from,from+frames) ranges; no freeze, loop or speed change; each shot1–4seconds. Motion occurs on the card and reading layers, not by time-stretching source.

graphic.text_policy: Explicit semantic title lines, editable current text; preserve names, negation, numbers and qualifiers. Validate legal capacity then actual-font fit and encoded readability.
graphic.asset_fit: contain is the sample default to preserve full robots and storefronts. cover/objectPosition are controlled fields requiring actual-frame review after crop change.

speech_free.rules: No narration, source speech, ASR, TTS or avatar slots. Only the current music+SFX master audio is rendered; all source videos muted.

operations.input: Current props + source mapping + title, actual original files, audio receipt and reviewed source windows.
operations.action: Validate current source/clock/text fields; prepare freezes props, original media hashes and implementation identity.
operations.output: Project artifacts/store-motion-request.json and verified source copies.
operations.completion: All required slots valid, master sample count exact, original intervals and review hashes match, zero-cloud and no-publication boundaries frozen.
operations.recovery: Repair missing input or review exact new interval; preserve original files and start a new frozen revision for changed inputs.

operations.input: Original frozen request and queue job.
operations.action: Submit idempotently through studio_investment_recompose/store-motion-showcase-v1; registered worker invokes VideoCompose/Remotion and final encoding.
operations.output: showcase.mp4, quality.json, result.json and candidate work record.
operations.completion: Queue status and media both complete; full decode, exact output grid, video stream>=20Mbps, audio true peak<=-1.5dBTP and current hashes pass.
operations.recovery: Read original job/request; reuse completed artifacts, resume original failed local stage. Runtime changes require a fresh frozen request.

operations.input: Current encoded sample, frozen props, source review, audio tracks and QA.
operations.action: Check all shot starts/moving midpoints/holds/endpoints, complete playback and separately recorded sound/target-device checks.
operations.output: Actual inspected-frame list, review scope, final identity and playable handoff.
operations.completion: Every applicable dimension has a fact-bound result; technical, sampled visual, continuous listening, platform and user acceptance remain distinct.
operations.recovery: Localize failing field and output time; fix source of truth, render fresh version and recheck affected/related dimensions.
